scope: Frozen correction-only host DEV diagnostic: Gemma receives the identical audio plus exact cached Parakeet Ultra transcript. No new audio, direct-ASR reruns, downloads or held-out inputs.

coverage.independence: Normal and quiet versions share seven recordings. One source per language. These controls do not represent all human quiet speech.

configuration.draft: Exact raw text from the completed, pinned Parakeet Ultra DEV-18 run on identical PCM
configuration.audio: Full 16 kHz mono PCM16, at most 30 seconds; no gate/VAD or amplitude change beyond frozen quiet inputs
configuration.policy: Collect every returned output, including output-contract failures. Native errors, deadlines and identity failures stop. Preserve raw JSON/visible text without stripping explanations, quotations or markup. No retry or prompt tuning.

passage_comparison_definition: Reference word-error counts per passage. Ties may hide one repaired mismatch and another newly introduced mismatch. Not semantic repair/damage counts.
noise_interpretation: Both Ultra drafts were empty. Gemma produced a 20-word explanation falsely claiming audio was unavailable and a 10-word invented quotation. Both are valid API text shapes but invalid transcripts. Audio/WAV/request bindings passed; the model statement is not evidence that audio was absent. Quotes and explanations remain in the scored text.

short_negation_controls.interpretation: English negative retained instead of French; wrong output language, but negative meaning is preserved. No affirmative inversion.
English negative changed to the correct Portuguese negative. This repairs the output-language mismatch.

invalid_output_fallback.counterfactual_policy: If the response violates the output contract, retain the exact Ultra draft. Report that fallback separately from raw candidate quality.
invalid_output_fallback.explanation: Neither noise response triggered the structural invalid-output rule. Fallback therefore does not remove the 30 hallucinated words. A future skip-empty-draft guard would avoid those two calls by construction, but was not executed and would not establish a measured speech-quality improvement.

observations: Russian reference mismatches decrease by two on the normal version and one on quiet; an inflection and one proper-name spelling move toward the reference.
Spanish retains the same WER: a plural-noun mismatch is repaired while a previously reference-matching pronoun is changed to singular. Aggregate ties conceal this exchange.
Italian adds one lexical error in both versions by spelling the same quantity as a word instead of digits; this is not evidence of a numerical meaning change.
The normal Portuguese proper name is altered but remains wrong; the previously mangled final numeric sequence is preserved in both versions. No numerical repair is established.
The main English residual term is left unchanged. German and French speech transcripts are preserved.
gain_and_damage_review.interpretation: Net speech WER improves by one error across 420 reference words; CER worsens by 14 across 2100 characters. The CER increase partly reflects Italian numeric formatting rather than numerical meaning damage. Some changes are useful, some are formatting, and some introduce new reference mismatches. This is insufficient evidence of a clear accuracy benefit for automatic correction.

completion_limits.interpretation: Counters below bounds and returned text do not prove EOS or absence of truncation. API structure validity does not imply transcription validity. The earlier Base screen remains INCOMPLETE and is not reclassified.

host_resources.limitations: Host-only single-run timing; no phone energy, thermals, background reliability or long-note evidence. Process lifetime RSS and cgroup memory peak differ in accounting. This adds model storage, load and per-note inference cost; no matched speed claim.

decision: Do not enable this Gemma correction profile by default. The stronger-draft comparison shows marginal net lexical improvement, worse CER partly caused by numeric formatting, changes within previously correct text, and additional runtime/storage cost. Noise failures reinforce the need for explicit gating but do not alone reject the model family. No further prompt or parameter tuning is included in this diagnostic.
